title: The Linguistic Structure of Dependency-Conditioned Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2611.25909v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dependency-based distributional models capture syntactically informed lexical similarities, but the geometric organisation of dependency-conditioned lexical representations remains underexplored. We investigate the global and local geometry of lemma-dependency relation embeddings using four representations trained on WikiText-103: two count-based PPMI configurations and two Skip-Gram with Negative Sampling (SGNS) configurations. At the global level, we analyse dependency-relation centroids, control for lexical identity through within-lemma centring, and examine their alignment with part-of-speech (POS) distributions. At the local level, we evaluate cross-relation geometric consistency, cross-method agreement, lexical similarity, and polysemous usages. Results show that global geometry is structured strongly by context POS across all representations. Locally, broader lexical similarity structures are partially preserved across dependency

translated_title: 依存条件化词嵌入的语言结构
translated_abstract: 基于依存的分布模型能够捕捉受句法信息引导的词汇相似性，但依存条件化词汇表示的几何组织方式仍未得到充分探索。我们使用在WikiText-103上训练的四种表示来研究词元-依存关系嵌入的全局与局部几何结构：两种基于计数的PPMI配置和两种带负采样的Skip-Gram（SGNS）配置。在全局层面，我们分析依存关系的质心，通过词元内中心化来控制词汇身份的影响，并考察其与词性（POS）分布的对齐情况。在局部层面，我们评估了跨关系的几何一致性、跨方法的一致性、词汇相似性以及多义词的不同用法。结果表明，在所有表示中，全局几何结构都受到上下文词性的强烈塑造。在局部层面，更广泛的词汇相似性结构在依存关系间得到了部分保留。
tldr: 该论文通过分析全局与局部几何结构，系统考察了依存条件化词嵌入的语言组织方式，发现全局几何主要由上下文词性塑造，而局部词汇相似性结构在依存关系间得到部分保留。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically examines the linguistic organization of dependency-conditioned embeddings through global and local geometric analysis, showing that global geometry is strongly structured by context POS while broader lexical similarity structures are partially preserved across dependency relations.
